note: Source capability register for the company registry. Each source says what it covers, what it does not, how it is collected and how often. Only sources marked active are collected.

sources.name: FDA Orange Book data files
sources.access: Zip of tilde-delimited text files, downloaded once a week
sources.cadence: FDA updates the files monthly; PV Info checks weekly
sources.reuse: US federal government data; no copyright restrictions on reuse
limitations: Covers drugs approved through NDAs and ANDAs. Most biologics, vaccines and biosimilars are licensed through BLAs and are not in the Orange Book.
The applicant is the holder of the application. It is not necessarily the manufacturer, distributor or the company that markets the product.
Approval does not prove the product is on the market. Products FDA lists as discontinued are shown as discontinued.

sources.name: EMA medicines data (human medicines report)
sources.access: Excel report, downloaded once a week
sources.cadence: EMA refreshes the report daily; PV Info checks weekly
sources.reuse: EMA website content may be reproduced with acknowledgement of the source, per EMA's legal notice
limitations: Centrally authorised medicines only. Medicines authorised nationally by EU member states are not included.
The holder shown is the marketing authorisation holder named in the current report. Earlier holders of transferred authorisations are not listed.
An EU authorisation does not prove the medicine is marketed in every member state.

sources.name: FDA Purple Book (licensed biologics)
limitations: Not collected yet. Needed for US biologics, vaccines and biosimilars.

sources.name: European Commission Union Register of medicinal products
limitations: Not collected yet. Would add authorisation history and transfers between holders.

sources.name: EMA public Article 57 data
limitations: Not collected yet. Would add nationally authorised products in the EEA; field and reuse checks are needed first.
